taxonomy_note: Workflow routing only. Choose final root-cause taxonomy from supported evidence.

controls.boundary: Configured tax/shipping calculation and quote-to-fulfillment integrity
controls.source_trace: Trace client inputs and quote IDs into the server total and the address/service actually fulfilled. Distinguish recalculated estimates from committed amounts.
controls.implementation_branch: Bind the quote to address, service, currency, quantity and applicable time policy. A merchant may deliberately honor a historical guaranteed quote. Compare final charged and fulfilled service values; do not call a legitimate estimate update or tax-inclusive display convention a price manipulation.
controls.operational_method: Retain the configured calculation policy: tax-inclusive/exclusive prices, shipping taxability, currency minor units, per-line versus invoice rounding and guaranteed-quote lifetime. Recompute an owned quote under that same policy, then change address/service/weight or a rounding boundary and inspect the final charge and fulfilled service. A mismatch between two legitimate rounding conventions is not a security finding; identify an unauthorized determinant change or value beyond the declared tolerance. This does not determine legal tax obligations.
controls.controlled_verification: Use a configured synthetic tax/shipping calculation with its inclusion, rounding and currency policy. Change one address/service/weight or rounding-boundary determinant and compare authorized quote, final charge and fulfilled service.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: A transient displayed estimate is not an undercharge; inspect authoritative charge and fulfillment state.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Recalculate or bind all quote determinants and retest legitimate address changes and stale-quote rejection.
